name: Li Ziqi (vlogger)
profileSummary: Li Ziqi is a Chinese video blogger, entrepreneur, and Internet celebrity. She is known for creating food and handicraft preparation videos in her hometown of rural Pingwu County, Mianyang, north-central Sichuan province, southwest China, often from basic ingredients and tools using traditional Chinese techniques. In February 2021, she received the Guinness World Record for "The most subscribers for a Chinese language channel on YouTube."
